question: The preferred IUPAC name of Allyl bromide is:
solution:
The Correct Answer is** 3-Bromopropene.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Allyl bromide is correctly named as 3-Bromopropene,**
 
• It indicating a three-carbon chain (propene) with a bromine atom attached to the third carbon. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Bromobutane is used as an intermediate in organic synthesis and as a solvent for cleaning and degreasing.
 
• It acts as an alkylating agent as well as to prepare organometallic compounds such as n-butyllithium.
 
• It is also involved in the synthesis of procaine and tetracaine.
